unit.why: An anecdote about several tzaddikim at a Rosh Chodesh Nisan meal in Zhidachov: R. Shimon of Jaroslaw perceives the Rozdol rabbi's hidden kavvanot, and a jest about eating nuts leads to a gematria teaching.

stories.start_quote: בשבת אחים גם יחד כמה צדיקים
stories.summary_en: At a gathering of tzaddikim in Zhidachov on Rosh Chodesh Nisan, R. Shimon of Jaroslaw senses that the Rozdol rabbi is eating with kavvanot. R. Shlomo of Dolina then jokes about whether nuts may be eaten on this 'New Year', and the Rozdol rabbi answers with a gematria showing that ten times 'nut' (= good) equals Nisan.
